remarks_1999: Backing inscription, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, Whitney Archive in 1969 date 1952. Dated 1951 on basis of a letter from O'Keeffe in which she indicates that she preferred to send this work to the 1952 Palm Beach exhibition rather than another painting of the same subject, see Appendix II, no. 126: "I have a better one in the vault that you can have by the time she will need it and the same title will do if you leave the date off" (O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 24 November 1951, Archive of American Art). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Lavender Iris

description: A pale purple iris with a yellow center blooms in front of a softly shaded white and pale pink background. Thin, bright green leaves stand behind the flower.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
